quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Ezra said, "I'm tired because I worked overtime all week."
quests.reportedSpeech: Ezra said that he was tired because he had worked overtime all week.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am tired' becomes 'was tired', and 'worked' (a finished action before the tiredness) becomes 'had worked'.
quests.nativeTip: Both the main clause and the reason clause need to backshift, and the reason describes something completed earlier.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Ezra said, "I'm tired because I worked overtime all week."" ➔ "Ezra said that he was tired because he had worked overtime all week."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The company said, "We are downsizing because sales have dropped this quarter."
quests.reportedSpeech: The company said that they were downsizing because sales had dropped that quarter.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Are downsizing' becomes 'were downsizing', 'have dropped' becomes 'had dropped', and 'this quarter' becomes 'that quarter'.
quests.nativeTip: Two different tenses need separate treatment here: the ongoing action and the completed one.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The company said, "We are downsizing because sales have dropped this quarter."" ➔ "The company said that they were downsizing because sales had dropped that quarter."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Simone said, "I can't come to the party because I promised to help my parents move."
quests.reportedSpeech: Simone said that she couldn't come to the party because she had promised to help her parents move.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can't' becomes 'couldn't', 'promised' becomes 'had promised', and 'my' becomes 'her'.
quests.nativeTip: The modal in the first clause and the verb in the reason clause both need to backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Simone said, "I can't come to the party because I promised to help my parents move."" ➔ "Simone said that she couldn't come to the party because she had promised to help her parents move."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Bertrand said, "Although I'm exhausted, I'll finish the report tonight."
quests.reportedSpeech: Bertrand said that although he was exhausted, he would finish the report that night.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am' becomes 'was', 'will finish' becomes 'would finish', and 'tonight' becomes 'that night'.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence has two clauses joined by 'although' — both need to backshift, and the time word changes too.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Bertrand said, "Although I'm exhausted, I'll finish the report tonight."" ➔ "Bertrand said that although he was exhausted, he would finish the report that night."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The manager said, "Even though we missed the deadline, the client is still satisfied."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that even though they had missed the deadline, the client was still satisfied.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Missed' becomes 'had missed' since it happened earlier, while 'is' simply backshifts to 'was'.
quests.nativeTip: The first clause describes a finished past action, so it backshifts one more step than the second clause.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "Even though we missed the deadline, the client is still satisfied."" ➔ "The manager said that even though they had missed the deadline, the client was still satisfied."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Odalys said, "Though I don't agree with the decision, I will support the team."
quests.reportedSpeech: Odalys said that though she didn't agree with the decision, she would support the team.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't agree' becomes 'didn't agree', and 'will support' becomes 'would support'.
quests.nativeTip: Both clauses backshift here — the present negative and the future modal.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Odalys said, "Though I don't agree with the decision, I will support the team."" ➔ "Odalys said that though she didn't agree with the decision, she would support the team."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher said, "If you study hard, you will pass the exam."
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher said that if I studied hard, I would pass the exam.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Study' becomes 'studied', and 'will pass' becomes 'would pass'; 'you' becomes 'I' throughout.
quests.nativeTip: Both parts of a first-conditional sentence backshift together: the if-clause and the result clause.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher said, "If you study hard, you will pass the exam."" ➔ "The teacher said that if I studied hard, I would pass the exam."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The mechanic said, "If the part arrives on time, we can finish the repair today."
quests.reportedSpeech: The mechanic said that if the part arrived on time, they could finish the repair that day.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Arrives' becomes 'arrived' (not 'had arrived', since this describes a general future condition, not an earlier completed action), 'can' becomes 'could', 'we' becomes 'they', and 'today' becomes 'that day'.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the if-clause verb, the modal, the pronoun, and the time word, but don't over-backshift the if-clause into a past perfect.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The mechanic said, "If the part arrives on time, we can finish the repair today."" ➔ "The mechanic said that if the part arrived on time, they could finish the repair that day."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Kenji said, "If I get the promotion, I'll take you all out to celebrate."
quests.reportedSpeech: Kenji said that if he got the promotion, he would take us all out to celebrate.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Get' becomes 'got', 'will take' becomes 'would take', and 'you' becomes 'us' since the reporter is among those being taken out.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift both clauses, and check who 'you' refers to if the listeners are the ones being reported to.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Kenji said, "If I get the promotion, I'll take you all out to celebrate."" ➔ "Kenji said that if he got the promotion, he would take us all out to celebrate."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Tense Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Perpetua said, "I always feel nervous before I give a presentation."
quests.reportedSpeech: Perpetua said that she always felt nervous before she gave a presentation.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Feel' becomes 'felt', and 'give' becomes 'gave'; no further backshift to past perfect is needed since this is a repeated pattern, not a single earlier event.
quests.nativeTip: This describes a repeated habit, so both verbs backshift by just one step, not two.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Perpetua said, "I always feel nervous before I give a presentation."" ➔ "Perpetua said that she always felt nervous before she gave a presentation."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Tobias said, "I called you as soon as I heard the news."
quests.reportedSpeech: Tobias said that he had called me as soon as he had heard the news.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Called' and 'heard' both become past perfect ('had called', 'had heard'), and 'you' becomes 'me'.
quests.nativeTip: Both actions happened before the moment of reporting, so both verbs move one more step back.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Tobias said, "I called you as soon as I heard the news."" ➔ "Tobias said that he had called me as soon as he had heard the news."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The nurse said, "While you were sleeping, your temperature went down."
quests.reportedSpeech: The nurse said that while I was sleeping, my temperature had gone down.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Were sleeping' stays as 'was sleeping' (already past continuous, describing a background action), while 'went down' becomes 'had gone down'; 'you'/'your' become 'I'/'my'.
quests.nativeTip: The ongoing action stays as past continuous, but the completed result backshifts one more step.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The nurse said, "While you were sleeping, your temperature went down."" ➔ "The nurse said that while I was sleeping, my temperature had gone down."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Ingrid2 said, "The book that you recommended was excellent."
quests.reportedSpeech: Ingrid2 said that the book that I had recommended was excellent.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Recommended' becomes 'had recommended' since it happened before the book was read, and 'you' becomes 'I'.
quests.nativeTip: The relative clause contains its own verb that needs to backshift, along with the pronoun.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Ingrid2 said, "The book that you recommended was excellent."" ➔ "Ingrid2 said that the book that I had recommended was excellent."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The manager said, "The employee who resigned yesterday was our best performer."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that the employee who had resigned the day before had been their best performer.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Resigned' becomes 'had resigned', 'was' becomes 'had been' (since it's describing a state before the resignation), 'yesterday' becomes 'the day before', and 'our' becomes 'their'.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence has two clauses, and both verbs need to backshift along with the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "The employee who resigned yesterday was our best performer."" ➔ "The manager said that the employee who had resigned the day before had been their best performer."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Esperanza said, "The house which we bought last year needs some repairs."
quests.reportedSpeech: Esperanza said that the house which they had bought the previous year needed some repairs.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Bought' becomes 'had bought', 'we' becomes 'they', 'needs' becomes 'needed', and 'last year' becomes 'the previous year'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the relative-clause backshift with the pronoun, the main-clause tense, and the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Esperanza said, "The house which we bought last year needs some repairs."" ➔ "Esperanza said that the house which they had bought the previous year needed some repairs."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The chef said, "The kitchen was so busy that I couldn't take a break."
quests.reportedSpeech: The chef said that the kitchen had been so busy that he couldn't take a break.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was' becomes 'had been' since it's a completed state, while 'couldn't' stays the same since it's already a past-time modal form.
quests.nativeTip: The first clause describes a finished situation, so it backshifts one more step than the second clause.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The chef said, "The kitchen was so busy that I couldn't take a break."" ➔ "The chef said that the kitchen had been so busy that he couldn't take a break."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Perpetua said, "The traffic was so bad that I arrived an hour late."
quests.reportedSpeech: Perpetua said that the traffic had been so bad that she had arrived an hour late.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was' becomes 'had been', and 'arrived' becomes 'had arrived'.
quests.nativeTip: Both clauses describe completed past events, so both backshift one more step.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Perpetua said, "The traffic was so bad that I arrived an hour late."" ➔ "Perpetua said that the traffic had been so bad that she had arrived an hour late."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher said, "The students were so quiet that I thought no one was there."
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher said that the students had been so quiet that she had thought no one was there.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Were' becomes 'had been', 'thought' becomes 'had thought', while 'was there' stays as 'was there' since it describes a simultaneous state, not an earlier one.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence has three verbs across two clauses — check each one for the correct level of backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher said, "The students were so quiet that I thought no one was there."" ➔ "The teacher said that the students had been so quiet that she had thought no one was there."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Emeka said, "I'm saving money so that I can travel next year."
quests.reportedSpeech: Emeka said that he was saving money so that he could travel the following year.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am saving' becomes 'was saving', 'can' becomes 'could', and 'next year' becomes 'the following year'.
quests.nativeTip: Both the main clause and the purpose clause backshift, along with the time word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Emeka said, "I'm saving money so that I can travel next year."" ➔ "Emeka said that he was saving money so that he could travel the following year."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The company said, "We are hiring more staff in order to meet demand."
quests.reportedSpeech: The company said that they were hiring more staff in order to meet demand.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Are hiring' becomes 'were hiring', and 'we' becomes 'they'; the purpose clause itself stays in its infinitive form.
quests.nativeTip: The purpose clause with 'in order to' doesn't change its structure — only the main clause backshifts.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The company said, "We are hiring more staff in order to meet demand."" ➔ "The company said that they were hiring more staff in order to meet demand."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Isabella said, "I'm learning Spanish so that I can talk to my grandmother here."
quests.reportedSpeech: Isabella said that she was learning Spanish so that she could talk to her grandmother there.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Am learning' becomes 'was learning', 'can' becomes 'could', 'my' becomes 'her', and 'here' becomes 'there'.
quests.nativeTip: This combines the tense, the modal, the pronoun, the possessive, and the place word.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Isabella said, "I'm learning Spanish so that I can talk to my grandmother here."" ➔ "Isabella said that she was learning Spanish so that she could talk to her grandmother there."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Wei said, "Although I was late, I didn't miss the meeting because it started late too."
quests.reportedSpeech: Wei said that although he had been late, he hadn't missed the meeting because it had started late too.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was' becomes 'had been', 'didn't miss' becomes 'hadn't missed', and 'started' becomes 'had started', since all three describe completed events before the moment of reporting.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence has three separate clauses joined by 'although' and 'because' — every verb needs to backshift one more step.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Wei said, "Although I was late, I didn't miss the meeting because it started late too."" ➔ "Wei said that although he had been late, he hadn't missed the meeting because it had started late too."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The manager said, "Even though sales dropped this month, we will keep our prices the same because our customers value quality."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that even though sales had dropped that month, they would keep their prices the same because their customers valued quality.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Dropped' becomes 'had dropped', 'will keep' becomes 'would keep', and 'value' becomes 'valued'; 'this month' becomes 'that month' and 'our' becomes 'their' throughout.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence has three clauses with three different verb changes — a completed action, a future plan, and an ongoing belief.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "Even though sales dropped this month, we will keep our prices the same because our customers value quality."" ➔ "The manager said that even though sales had dropped that month, they would keep their prices the same because their customers valued quality."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Halima said, "Because I finished early, I offered to help you, even though you said you didn't need it."
quests.reportedSpeech: Halima said that because she had finished early, she had offered to help me, even though I had said I didn't need it.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Finished'/'offered'/'said' all become past perfect since they describe a sequence of completed past events, and 'you' becomes 'me'/'I' since the listener is now the one reporting.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence has four separate clauses — track each pronoun and verb through the whole passage.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Halima said, "Because I finished early, I offered to help you, even though you said you didn't need it."" ➔ "Halima said that because she had finished early, she had offered to help me, even though I had said I didn't need it."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The detective asked, "Do you know the man who was standing near the door?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The detective asked whether I knew the man who had been standing near the door.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Do you know' becomes 'whether I knew', and 'was standing' becomes 'had been standing'.
quests.nativeTip: Both the main question and the relative clause inside it need to backshift, plus the word order.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The detective asked, "Do you know the man who was standing near the door?"" ➔ "The detective asked whether I knew the man who had been standing near the door."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The teacher asked, "Can you explain why the experiment that we did failed?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The teacher asked whether I could explain why the experiment that they had done had failed.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', 'we' becomes 'they', 'did' becomes 'had done', and 'failed' becomes 'had failed'.
quests.nativeTip: This nested question has three levels — the main question, an embedded 'why' clause, and a relative clause inside that.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "Can you explain why the experiment that we did failed?"" ➔ "The teacher asked whether I could explain why the experiment that they had done had failed."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The interviewer asked, "What would you do if the plan that you proposed didn't work?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The interviewer asked what I would do if the plan that I had proposed didn't work.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Proposed' becomes 'had proposed', while 'didn't work' stays the same since it describes a general hypothetical condition, not an earlier completed event.
quests.nativeTip: This combines a reported question, a conditional clause, and a relative clause all in one sentence.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The interviewer asked, "What would you do if the plan that you proposed didn't work?"" ➔ "The interviewer asked what I would do if the plan that I had proposed didn't work."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Rafael said, "Even though I was nervous, I gave the presentation because my manager asked me to."
quests.reportedSpeech: Rafael said that even though he had been nervous, he had given the presentation because his manager had asked him to.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Was', 'gave', and 'asked' all backshift to their past perfect forms since they describe a sequence of completed events.
quests.nativeTip: This review question has three clauses, each describing a completed action before the moment of reporting.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Rafael said, "Even though I was nervous, I gave the presentation because my manager asked me to."" ➔ "Rafael said that even though he had been nervous, he had given the presentation because his manager had asked him to."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The scientist said, "If we don't reduce emissions, the situation that we're facing today will get worse."
quests.reportedSpeech: The scientist said that if they didn't reduce emissions, the situation that they were facing that day would get worse.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Don't reduce' becomes 'didn't reduce', 'are facing' becomes 'were facing', 'will get' becomes 'would get', and 'today' becomes 'that day'.
quests.nativeTip: This combines a conditional clause, a relative clause, and a future modal — check the correct level of backshift for each.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The scientist said, "If we don't reduce emissions, the situation that we're facing today will get worse."" ➔ "The scientist said that if they didn't reduce emissions, the situation that they were facing that day would get worse."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: Thandiwe said, "The colleague who helped me finish the project so that we could meet the deadline deserves recognition."
quests.reportedSpeech: Thandiwe said that the colleague who had helped her finish the project so that they could meet the deadline deserved recognition.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Helped' becomes 'had helped' since it happened before the deadline, 'me' becomes 'her', 'we' becomes 'they', and 'deserves' becomes 'deserved'.
quests.nativeTip: This final review question combines a relative clause, a purpose clause, and the main verb — each needing its own backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Thandiwe said, "The colleague who helped me finish the project so that we could meet the deadline deserves recognition."" ➔ "Thandiwe said that the colleague who had helped her finish the project so that they could meet the deadline deserved recognition."
